A_CUMULATIVE_NORMAL_EXTENSION.meaning: Time integral of non-negative relative boundary-normal opening displacement.
advantages: directly driven by already-authorized relative plate kinematics
has a natural zero initial condition
A_CUMULATIVE_NORMAL_EXTENSION.limits: Not crustal strain, beta, damage, fault slip, or a full lithospheric deformation solution; no effective zone width is inferred.

B_EXTENSIONAL_STRAIN.reason: Requires a governed effective deforming width; no such R6 width is materialized.

C_STRETCHING_FACTOR_BETA.reason: Requires initial/final crustal or lithospheric thickness and a spatially coherent stretching model, which are not available for this t0 event envelope.

D_DAMAGE_OR_RIFT_MATURITY.reason: Requires rheology, weakening/damage laws, and calibrated state parameters absent from R6.

initial_state.scope: synthetic ARCANA t0 only; not an observation about Earth at 210 Ma

driver_and_transition_law.progress_rate: max(0, signed local boundary-normal relative velocity)
driver_and_transition_law.spatial_scope: boundary-edge segment; census aggregates diagnostics by adjacent plate pair, and the event guard uses the fastest supported positive edge driver
driver_and_transition_law.if_opening_velocity_le_zero: progress stalls; no healing, relaxation, or reset is authorized
driver_and_transition_law.event_condition: RIFT_INITIATION becomes possible when E >= theta under positive opening; this operational model event marks activation of the rift-process state, not plate splitting or mature breakup
driver_and_transition_law.event_localization: For a constant first motion segment, analytically solve dt_event = (theta - E) / u_open; a proposed step may not cross the event boundary. A production integrator must stop/localize at that boundary under a solver-specific tolerance before event application.

weakness_semantics.modifier: not numerically applied; no weakness value or province/suture-to-weakness inference
weakness_semantics.conservative_treatment: The guard uses the most event-permissive lower threshold in the explicitly authorial threshold envelope. This is a model envelope, not a physical strength estimate.
weakness_semantics.future_richer_model: A separately authorized weakness/rheology modifier may refine the threshold/process law; it cannot retroactively alter this t0 realization.

threshold_authority.interpretation: ARCANA defines its coarse global-base rift-process activation event after 5-30 km of accumulated opening. The interval is an explicit model uncertainty envelope, not a universal natural rift-initiation threshold; regional observations/models provide only contextual extension scales and do not calibrate this threshold.
threshold_authority.event_semantics_limit: Sub-threshold extension is represented only as a latent progress state. No fault, damage, topography, crustal thinning, or rift geometry is asserted before or at the activation event.

first_segment_policy.motion: Hold the canonical t0 Euler state constant only through the first segment and stop at the earliest event/law boundary; no long-term persistence is implied.
first_segment_policy.motion_renewal: NOT_EXERCISED_WITHIN_FIRST_SEGMENT; P03 remains unbound beyond the first segment.
first_segment_policy.first_segment_end_upper_bound: earliest conservative t0 event-time bound, subject to the unresolved numerical horizon
first_segment_policy.event_progress_initialization: zero at exact t0 for every supported candidate boundary edge

numerical_policy.scientific_event_guard: computed from lower threshold and maximum local positive t0 opening rate
required_before_dt: maximum vertex displacement or equivalent verified geometry error limit

p09_semantics: DEFERRED_UNTIL_RIFT_INITIATION; no plate split or lineage change is defined by this guard-only law.

research_references.use: Earth reconstruction speed context only; not an R6 rift law.
Shows extension modes depend on crustal thickness, heat flow, strain rate and rheology; supports rejecting beta/strain as a minimal state when those fields are absent.
Rift initiation/evolution is transient and depends on driving, resistance, weakening and inheritance; no universal transferable onset threshold.
Regional East African Rift example with >10 km extension in the Lokichar Basin; contextual scale only, not an onset threshold or global transfer authority.
Numerical study demonstrates extension rate and rheological interaction influence rift evolution and delay localization; setting-specific, not a universal delay.
